cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; an indoor book cafe with a gentle sloping carpeted reading ramp — sliding playfully down the low reading ramp on a wide seat cushion; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — standing; a small botanical conservatory hosting a playful public reading event — performing the finale of a story as an imaginary deep-sea cartographer; the top of a restored ancient city wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — perched on a ledge or edge; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; a night observatory under an open dome — reads a book held open in both hands; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries her keepsake low at her side
